role: Probe tests that BreadcrumbRecorder.shared (which builds a CLLocationManager and loads the persisted trail) can be constructed in the test host, reports a valid CLAuthorizationStatus, and has no active trail.
types: BreadcrumbRecorderProbeTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase probing the BreadcrumbRecorder singleton

units.does: Touches BreadcrumbRecorder.shared (forcing singleton init) and asserts it is non-nil.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: XCTAssertNotNil on a non-optional singleton reference is a tautology; the only thing actually tested is that init does not crash.

units.does: Asserts BreadcrumbRecorder.shared.authorizationStatus is one of the five CLAuthorizationStatus cases.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: The five listed cases are every CLAuthorizationStatus case, so the assertion cannot fail for any value CoreLocation returns.

units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: BreadcrumbRecorder.init restores activeTrail from the on-disk breadcrumb store (Breadcrumbs/active.json) of the host app, so the test fails on any simulator/device where the app host previously recorded a trail; it shares persisted state with the app host rather than testing 'before any recording'.
